duration: 72 hours from explicit approval and verified application, never beyond 2026-10-19T23:59:59-03:00
review: Compare impressions, eligible queries, clicks, actual CPC, cost, and paid project_start. No causal/statistical claim from sparse data; no automatic renewal.
stop: Pause only Mapa if cumulative cost >= EUR28, authorized end, proven measurement failure or quality/privacy violation. Existing hourly rule is not a strict instantaneous spending cap.
rollback: Return ceiling to EUR0.30 after 72 hours if campaign is still within authorization; never reactivate a paused campaign. Further changes need authorization.
application_preflight: Re-read spend, status, rule, authorization, campaign dates and landing before application. Await explicit user approval; this proposal is not permission.
rationale: EUR0.45 is a conservative 50% single-variable step chosen as an experiment, not a forecast or an observed required first-page bid. Current API bid estimates unavailable.
